acceptance_criteria: [Spec Delivery: Init, O2, O5, N3] ai-catapult init writes .ai/policies/readiness-policy.json from the vendored ai-catapult-init template of ACH-S-02 as rechecked at O8 (skills f5e338b92bb754c2bfffdf542b498530258fdbc0): readiness-policy/2, identity_model multi, fail-closed placeholders (anchor_sha256 null and empty required_checks, each a named admission gap); the seeded approval block is the template's verbatim (accept ["agent-self", "ssh-tag", "in-session"], default_mode agent), so a seeded repository is agent-self-capable from its first commit (decision N3, accepted and recorded); an existing file is never overwritten without --force.

[Fixture conformance after proposed transfer] C-02 supplies the lock-coupled init policy fixture and achieves its own full green first. C-03 leaves that fixture byte-unchanged and retains test/init.test.ts and test/packed-init.test.ts for emitted-policy semantics, exact source/packed policy equality at fixed inputs and policy-specific collision/--force conformance. scripts/regen-fixture.ts remains the canonical regeneration mechanism in C-03 scope; a discovered additional fixture edit needs explicit reviewed scope before implementation, never a silent directory expansion. Both tests run under the complete npm test.

[Contract] A test validates the emitted policy with the vendored v2 validator (python3 -I -B) and asserts that admission names the anchor_unset and required_checks_unset gaps, and asserts the seeded approval.accept and approval.default_mode exactly as decision N3 fixes them.
[Lane] Source and packaged: the packed-init path emits the same bytes as the source path.

[Spec Delivery: Backfill] ai-catapult backfill --policy-v2 --root <repo> runs only when invoked explicitly (never from init or install) and writes the baseline policy/2 candidate only when the repository has no policy, or a v1 policy whose registry has no active plan.

[Active by ancestry] backfill calls the vendored contract-run.sh inventory-v1 rather than reimplementing it (merged = a hosted-API merged PR whose head branch carries the goal id as a token (case-insensitive, bounded by non-alphanumerics) and whose merge commit is an ancestor of origin/main; commit and title text are never signals); a v1 registry plan is active only when it is in flight (an unmerged goal has an open PR or an unmerged origin branch carrying its token); completed plans are not active, unstarted and partly merged plans are not active but are listed as requiring migration of their unmerged goals (O10), and an unreachable hosted API or an unattributable token match counts as active.

[Fail closed] While any plan is active it refuses with one consolidated report naming them; it refuses when a policy/2 with different bytes exists; it never writes approvals, anchors or readiness contexts, writes nothing outside --root, and refuses symlinked or out-of-root targets.

[Idempotent, ledgered] A second run with the same inputs is a no-op that exits 0; every run appends {schema, command, repository id, before_sha256, after_sha256, at, result} to .ai/drift/backfill-ledger.jsonl; --dry-run prints the diff without writing; test/backfill.test.ts (discovered by node --test under npm test) covers fresh, active, completed, unstarted, partly merged, policy/2-present, rerun and dry-run fixtures, including a two-plan P4/TSWC registry so an in-flight second entry cannot be missed.

The plugin manifests generated by scripts/build-claude-plugin.ts, build-codex-plugin.ts and build-opencode-plugin.ts carry it.
